subject: Create Rust build infrastructure for Crucible
description:
Phase 1 of Crucible integration: Set up Rust workspace and FFI bindings.

Tasks:
1. Create Rust workspace structure:
   - rust/Cargo.toml (workspace root)
   - rust/osv-sys/ (FFI bindings to OSv C APIs)
   - rust/crucible-osv/ (Crucible integration)
2. Implement osv-sys with bindgen:
   - build.rs to generate bindings
   - Bind: device, bio, devops, driver types
   - Bind: alloc_bio, destroy_bio, biodone, device_create functions
3. Integrate Rust build into Makefile:
   - Compile to staticlib: libcrucible_osv.a
   - Link into kernel when conf_drivers_crucible=1

Critical files:
- rust/osv-sys/build.rs (bindgen configuration)
- rust/osv-sys/wrapper.h (headers to bind)
- Makefile (Rust build rules)

Timeline: 2 weeks
